newsitem.title: KENYA: Some 30 refugees wounded in Zaire - aid official.
newsitem.headline: Some 30 refugees wounded in Zaire - aid official.

text.p: Some 30 Rwandan Hutu refugees were wounded overnight and on Saturday by shooting, triggering a fresh refugee exodus in eastern Zaire, an aid official said.

"There is shooting in Kibumba camp. This morning 30 people who were injured were brought to our hospital in Kibumba," said Elodie Martel, head of the Goma delegation of the International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies (IFRC).

"A large number of refugees are apparently walking towards Goma. The shooting started on Friday and is in the surrounding area and in the camp itself," said Martel, adding she could not confirm all 200,000 residents from Kibumba had fled the camp.
"People are running all around the place," she told Reuters by telephone from Goma.

She said the attackers were not identified but appeared to be the same group as Tutsi rebels fighting the Zairean army for more than a week in South Kivu province, where nearly 300,000 refugees have fled.
Asked whether the gunmen in Kibumba were exchanging fire with Zairean troops charged with guarding the camp, she said the Zairean commander in Goma had lost contact with his men on Saturday.
